headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, there was a changing of the guard for the AEW TNT Title as Sammy Guevara vs. Miro battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.40 ? a solid showing ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Ending a dominant undefeated singles reign, capped on a deeply meaningful night dedicated to the memory of the late Brodie Lee in his own hometown ? Guevara's best friend Fuego Del Sol helped set up the finish, sending Miro into his own exposed turnbuckle before the 630 splash sealed the title win.
2023 brought us this moment: Hikaru Shida vs. Ruby Soho met in a Number One Contender, in the show-closing main event slot on Rampage, rated 7.21 ? a strong outing.

It was 2021 when Jungle Boy chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a solid half-century of matches, facing Adam Cole vs. Jungle Boy, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 7.69 ? a solid showing.

secondaries.text: It was 2021 when Jora Johl competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Dark Order (Grayson & Uno) vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) vs. Private Party vs. The Butcher and The Blade vs. The Hybrid2 vs. Orange Cassidy vs. Evil Uno vs. Stu Grayson vs. Alex Reynolds vs. John Silver vs. Alan Angels vs. Colt Cabana vs. Ten vs. Matt Hardy vs. Isiah Kassidy vs. Marq Quen vs. The Butcher vs. The Blade vs. Angelico vs. Jack Evans, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.03.
Back on this day in 2023, Isiah Kassidy returned to the fold after 6 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.

2023 brought us this moment: Eddie Kingston vs. Rocky Romero went to battle over the NJPW STRONG Openweight Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.20. Rocky Romero was challenging for gold for the very first time.
